title: Dana RS not regularly reading reservoir
body:
I noticed yesterday AAPS was reporting 40 units in the reservoir for several hours.  
On tapping the Bluetooth icon it dropped to  23. 
Today I took a couple of screenshots showing before and after tapping the Bluetooth icon. 
I'm on 2.8. I didn't notice this happen on 2.7 but I'm not certain it didn't. 
Will email logs now.
